verdict.rationale: Box's REST API exposes per-item endpoints (search, metadata, collaborations, webhooks, chunked upload) that an AI agent could script in a loop to affect many items, and the MCP server/CLI expose these to agents, but the evidence pack contains no documentation of a native batch/bulk endpoint (e.g., bulk delete, bulk metadata update, multi-item transactions) — everything is framed as single-resource operations that must be automated by the caller. missing for 10: explicit batch/bulk API endpoints, documented rate-limit or throughput guidance for large-scale bulk jobs, and independent evidence of bulk workflows succeeding at scale.
